{{Top|leg}}
'''Latoprene''' was a substance, derived from sophisticated [[Plastic/Legends|plastics]], that was used on [[Droid/Legends|droids]] to camouflage their metallic surface and allow them to "appear" [[Sentience/Legends|organic]] in nature. Clothing could then be placed over the simulated skin, increasing the deception.

In [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]],<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> [[Ottdefa/Legends|Ottdefa]] [[Osuno Whett/Legends|Osuno Whett]] applied latoprene to [[Vuffi Raa]]'s torso, in an attempt to deceive the government of [[Mathilde]] on [[Renatasia III]] .
